entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane of kithkin, merrows, giants, flamekin, boggarts, elves and treefolk, where evenings are brief.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Small folk woven into their clans, linked by the thoughtweft, who fight fiercely without self-interest.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: A link among kithkin minds.

entities.name: Galanda Feudkiller
entities.description: A speaker about strength of soul.

entities.name: Moran the Destroyer
entities.description: A giant who fought Odum and Broadbark for a hundred dawns, then fell into namesleep and awoke as Moran the Gardener.

entities.name: Odum
entities.description: A being mighty enough to challenge Moran the Destroyer.

entities.name: Broadbark
entities.description: A being mighty enough to challenge Moran the Destroyer.

entities.name: Lann of Cloverdell
entities.description: A speaker about riding springjacks.

entities.name: Merrows
entities.description: Water folk whose schools form around the wisest teachers.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen whose song steals dreams and rumors and who is the origin of faeries.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Beings who return to Oona with stolen dreams and rumors.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: A hunter whose perfect day was tainted by clouds.

entities.name: Calydd
entities.description: A kithkin farmer.

entities.name: Ashling the Pilgrim
entities.description: A pilgrim vexed by merrows.

entities.name: Maralen of the Mornsong
entities.description: An elf who sent the Vendilion clique on a grave task.

entities.name: Veesa
entities.description: A member of the Vendilion clique.

entities.name: Endry
entities.description: A member of the Vendilion clique.

entities.name: Iliona
entities.description: A member of the Vendilion clique.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: A clique of three faeries sent by Maralen on grave tasks.

entities.name: Desmera
entities.description: A perfect of Wren's Run.

entities.name: Wren's Run
entities.description: A place in Lorwyn.

entities.name: Cenn Deagan
entities.description: A speaker who warns of the stenchskipper.

entities.name: Frogtossers
entities.description: A boggart warren that threads trophies into standards.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Creatures with just half a brain who each have an auntie.

entities.name: Auntie Wort
entities.description: A boggart auntie in a tale.

entities.name: Byoog
entities.description: A boggart who tried to pull up a root for stew.

entities.name: Giants
entities.description: Furious creatures who bring attention.

entities.name: Flamekin
entities.description: Fire folk whose emissaries bring mastery of fire to other races.

entities.name: Brighthearth
entities.description: The flamekin goodwill that gives mastery of fire to others.

entities.name: Illulia
entities.description: A flamekin soulstoke.

entities.name: Tollek Worldwatcher
entities.description: The author of a journal on flamekin death rites.

entities.name: Vessifrus
entities.description: A flamekin demagogue.

entities.name: Olly of Goldmeadow
entities.description: A speaker troubled by changelings.

entities.name: Changelings
entities.description: Shapeshifters, some born at Velis Vel.

entities.name: Velis Vel
entities.description: A place where changelings are born.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Elves of the forest, graceful and deadly warriors who feel at home above.

entities.name: Treefolk
entities.description: Beings who share forests with elves and whose minds renew after the Rising.

entities.name: The Rising
entities.description: An event after which a treefolk's mind is limber and green.

entities.name: Gremil
entities.description: A person who felt in touch with nature.

entities.name: Twila
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf archdruid.

entities.name: Rhys the Exiled
entities.description: A former hunter and packmaster, now a renegade.

entities.name: Colfenor, the Last Yew
entities.description: A treefolk speaker.

entities.name: Eyeblights
entities.description: Elves deemed imperfect by their kin.

events.summary: Odum and Broadbark fight the giant Moran the Destroyer for a hundred dawns until he falls into namesleep and awakens as Moran the Gardener.
events.quote: Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep.

events.summary: Maralen sends the Vendilion clique on the gravest of tasks.
events.quote: Maralen sent Veesa, Endry, and Iliona—the Vendilion clique—on the gravest of tasks.

events.summary: Gryffid wishes clouds away from his hunt, and the clouds make a wish of their own.
Byoog tries to pull up a root and the root pulls back.
events.quote: he didn't expect the root to pull back.
